name: Sketch
source: Sketch after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. Unlike her adult form it appears she cannot make her drawings come to life. She also uses crayons to draw instead of a pencil. She calls Leo 'papa' and demands money from him. She claims it's because she's a criminal.
